q: Healthy ecosystem and rich ____ will protect fresh water resources. (2025-Set 10)
e: Biodiversity in healthy ecosystems plays a key role in maintaining and protecting freshwater resources.

q: Rainfall and elevation strongly influence the distribution of different ____ types. (2025-Set 13)
e: Climatic factors such as rainfall and elevation dictate the distribution of plant cover and vegetation types.

q: Forest ecosystems are a ____ sink and stabilize soils. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား/2025-Set 3, 7)
e: Forests absorb atmospheric carbon dioxide, serving as carbon sinks while preventing soil erosion.

q: Rhododendron is the ____ plant species. (2025-Set 13)
e: Rhododendron species face habitat threats and are classified as endangered plant species.

q: Biodiversity ensures natural ____ for all life on the earth. (2025-Set 9)
e: Rich biodiversity sustains ecological processes vital for long-term life on Earth.

q: Pollution is a growing threat on both land and in ____ ecosystems. (2026-Set 1)
e: Environmental pollutants affect terrestrial as well as aquatic habitats.

q: The destruction of the natural environment leads to ____ loss. (2025-Set 3,11 / 2026-Set 2)
e: Degrading natural ecosystems results directly in the loss of species' natural habitats.

q: Habitat size and number of ____ are systematically related. (2025-Set 7)
e: The total area of a habitat directly correlates with the diversity and number of species it can support.

q: Habitat destruction has played a key role in ____. (2024-Set 2/2025-Set 4, 5)
e: Destruction of habitats is a major cause of global species extinction.

q: Myanmar is a large ____ country. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အချို့တွင်မေး/2025-Set 5)
e: Agricultural activity forms a central part of land use and biodiversity in Myanmar.

q: Canal construction and urbanization are major threats to the ____ of Myanmar. (2025-Set 6)
e: Human developments such as canals and urban expansion disrupt agricultural ecosystems and crop diversity.

q: A variety of human activities threatens the ____ of Myanmar. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းခရိုင်အချို့တွင်မေး Set 4)
e: Human activity poses significant challenges to sustaining agricultural biodiversity.

q: Genetic ____ indicates the loss of identity of wild plant species. (2025-Set 2)
e: Genetic pollution compromises the natural genetic purity and identity of wild species.

q: Genetic pollution is undesirable ____ flow into wild populations. (2025-Set 12)
e: It occurs when foreign genes flow uncontrollably into natural gene pools.

q: Genetic pollution is ____ gene flow into wild populations. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Uncontrolled transfer of genes into wild populations causes unwanted evolutionary consequences.

q: Illegal wildlife trade contributes directly to the loss of species and habitat ____. (2025-Set 6)
e: The illegal wildlife trade damages natural habitats and severely reduces wildlife populations.

q: Smuggled wildlife is an increasing ____ demand. (2025-Set 1)
e: Wildlife trafficking is driven by a expanding market and global demand.

q: The most trafficked animal in the world is the ____. (2025-Set 9, 10)
e: Pangolins are targeted heavily for illegal commercial trade in scales and meat.

q: Wildlife trade can be differentiated in legal and ____ trade. (2025-Set 12)
e: Commerce in wild animals and plants falls into authorized legal trade and illicit illegal trade.

q: Wildlife ____ directly affects the biodiversity of different ecosystems. (2024-Set 3)
e: Smuggling removes species from their natural environments, altering food webs and ecosystem balance.

q: Pangolins are the only ____ mammal on earth. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း)
e: Pangolins are uniquely identified as the only mammalian species with large protective scales.

q: One of the techniques used in captive breeding programmes is embryo transfer to a ____ mother. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Surrogate mothers are utilized in captive breeding to gestate embryos of endangered species.

q: The best way to conserve any species is to keep it in its ____ habitat. (2025-Set 8)
e: In-situ conservation in a species' natural habitat is the most effective conservation method.

q: Seed banks have been set up to help conserve ____ plants species. (2024-Set 3/2025-Set 2)
e: Ex-situ facilities like seed banks preserve genetic resources of rare plant species.

q: Botanical gardens are places to integrate the study of ____ on plant species. (2025-Set 1)
e: Botanical gardens facilitate scientific research, propagation, and plant conservation.

q: Protected areas are important tools for ____ conservation and sustainable development. (2025-Set 8)
e: Establishing protected zones supports biodiversity conservation while encouraging sustainable land management.

q: The capturing, killing and poaching of animals is strictly ____ in wildlife sanctuary. (2025-Set 11)
e: Sanctuaries strictly enforce legal prohibitions against hunting or capturing wildlife.

q: A national park is an area set aside by a national government for the ____ of the natural environment. (2024-Set 4)
e: National parks preserve pristine environments and biodiversity under governmental protection.

q: A marine park is a permanent marine reservation for the conservation of ____. (2024-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Marine parks are designated zones intended to conserve ocean species and ecosystems.
